title: ESPRIT workflows and connector status
description: Explore ESPRIT workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

ESPRIT

ESPRIT supports CNC programming, digital-machine simulation and production optimisation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a digital machine setup

Begin with the selected part, stock, CNC machine, cutting tools and fixtures. In the intended ESPRIT preview, build a digital machine setup; the visible result is a proposed machining setup with work coordinates, stock and target geometry visible. Review orientation, tooling and fixture assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Program turning and milling

Use the chosen machining operations and cutting tools. In the intended ESPRIT preview, program turning and milling; the visible result is a proposed toolpath over the reviewed machining setup. Review clearance, collisions, machine limits, feeds and operation order before accepting or exporting it.

Simulate the machining cycle

Start from the machining simulation and material-removal results. In the intended ESPRIT preview, simulate the machining cycle; the visible result is a proposed verification view with remaining stock and cycle data exposed. Review collisions, machine and post-processor target, cycle assumptions and human approval before accepting or exporting it.

Source and compatibility

ESPRIT capability context — manual primary-source review

Manual review of vendor text exposed by the web tool on 2026-10-06 is recorded in product-claim-sources.json. Historical failed raw retrieval remains preserved; no HTTP success or vendor-body hash is inferred. Capability context does not prove Vector OS implementation, native execution or engineering acceptance.

Exact versions and native qualification remain separate.
